integrity: Proof given by exact spectral-calculus reduction, triangular trigonometric inversion, Chebyshev moments and finite Vandermonde uniqueness. Numerical tests are diagnostic; no independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional unitary operators, or a known finite bound on distinct projective spectral classes; identifies only unordered cyclic gap lengths, not cyclic order, unitary equivalence, sign choices or multiplicities. Sufficient measurement count not claimed minimal. Broader inverse-distance distribution literature may cover a related result.
title: Finite even Cartesian-radius moments recover the unordered projective spectral gaps of unitaries
